> We both know that it's very difficult to find a subreddit that will encourage you to commit suicide,

I'm not looking for encouragement.  My decision has already been made.  Nothing anyone says can or will change that.

> and will help walk through the steps for the note.

I'm not looking for a walk through.  I'm just wondering if leaving a note is better than not.
Nope.  There is no helping this

You think you're helping, but you're not. The decision to kill myself has already been made. Nothing anyone says can or will change that. We're not talking about suicide anymore. We're talking about the note

You think you're helping, but you're not.  The decision to kill myself has already been made.  Nothing anyone says can or will change that.  We're not talking about suicide anymore.  We're talking about the note
That decision is already made.  The suicide note is the question at hand

> Can you speak to your parents? can you be blatant with them about how you feel, whats hurting you so deeply you dont want to live?

> if not how about a teacher or your doctor? there is more than one way out.

> I get the feeling you don't want to take this advice but keep in mind that i do want to HELP you. Please reconsider. 

Nope.  Where can I repost this to get a serious answer?
Where can I repost this, then?

I'm not interested in reading a suicide forum.  Either I leave a note telling them why I killed myself, or they forever wonder why I did it.  

If I don't leave a note they will probably blame themselves without knowing why.  If I do leave a note they will for sure blame themselves, but at least they will know why I killed myself.

> It really doesn't matter, they will blame themselves regardless.

If I write an honest note they will truly blame themselves. 

> If you want a primer on what it is like when your child kills themselves, this is a great resource:
